title: Joint petition of Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company and UMC Electric Company, Inc., for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of (1) the issue and sale by UMC of 1,000 shares of common stock, $1.00 par value, to Unitil Corporation for a consideration of $1,000, pursuant to the provisions of M.G.L. 164, § 14, (2) .the merger of UMC with and into Fitchburg, pursuant to M.G.L. c. 164, § 96, and (3) participation by Fitchburg in a Cash Pooling and Loan Agreement by and among Unitil and the subsidiaries of Unitil, pursuant to M.G.L. c. 164, § 17A.
petitioner: Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company d/b/a Unitil
